step2.title: Self-Assessment
step2.subtitle: For matching 'Chosen Guide' tags, please evaluate yourself honestly
step2.sliderInstruction: Choose the position that best reflects your natural approach. Neither end is automatically better.
step2.q1Question: Q1. If a guest makes a request during the experience that is outside the original plan and may violate local rules or create a safety risk, how would you respond? (Select all that apply.)

q1Options.understandRequest: Ask for more information about what the guest wants before deciding whether the request is feasible.
q1Options.refuseUnsafe: Decline any part of the request that is illegal, unsafe, or clearly outside the agreed scope of service, and explain why.
q1Options.offerAlternative: When possible, suggest a legal and safe alternative.
q1Options.contactPlatform: Contact the platform if the situation continues, becomes disputed, or requires additional support.
q1Options.satisfyFirst: Try to accommodate the request first to avoid disappointing the guest.
q1Options.doNotEngage: Treat it as the guest’s personal decision and avoid getting involved, without offering an explanation or assistance.

step2.q1SliderTooltip: When a guest makes an unexpected request, which approach is closer to your natural first instinct?
step2.q1Range1: 1 — I first explore whether the request can be accommodated
step2.q1Range9: 9 — I first check whether the request is appropriate and within clear boundaries
step2.q2Question: Q2. When providing Guide services, I am generally willing to adjust my own plans to accommodate a guest’s needs.
step2.q3Question: Q3. When a guest appears to be having difficulty or does not seem well, what would you usually do first?

q3Options.askAndSupport: Ask whether they need help and provide support based on their response.
q3Options.observeThenCheck: Observe the situation first and briefly check in at an appropriate moment.
q3Options.activelyHelp: Proactively stay with them and help them resolve the problem.
q3Options.waitForRequest: Respect their space and wait until they clearly ask for assistance.
q3Options.doNotIntervene: Unless they directly ask for help, I would generally not intervene.

step2.q3SliderTooltip: When a guest appears to be having difficulty, which response feels more natural to you?
step2.q3Range1: 1 — I tend to check in and offer help proactively
step2.q3Range9: 9 — I tend to give them space and wait for clearer signals
step2.q4Question: Q4. What types of interaction would you like to have with guests during an experience? (Select all that apply.)

q4Options.shareStories: Start conversations and share appropriate personal experiences or local stories.
q4Options.localConnections: When everyone is comfortable and the arrangement is appropriate, introduce guests to local people or invite them to participate in local activities.
q4Options.takePhotos: Help guests take photos and document their trip when they would like you to.
q4Options.adjustPace: Adjust the interaction style or pace of the experience according to the guest’s needs and condition.
q4Options.quietCompany: Travel quietly with guests without creating pressure to keep talking.
q4Options.giveSpace: Give guests enough freedom to explore at their own pace.
q4Options.stayInTouch: Remain in contact after the experience if both the guest and Guide would like to.
q4Options.professionalRelationship: Remain friendly and courteous while keeping the relationship primarily professional after the experience.

step2.q4SliderTooltip: What level of interaction feels most natural to you during an experience?
step2.q4Range1: 1 — I prefer an active, social, and shared experience
step2.q4Range9: 9 — I prefer a quieter experience with more independence and personal space

step3.title: Personalized Questions
step3.subtitle: Help us understand your guiding preferences and strengths
step3.sliderInstruction: Choose the position that best reflects your natural approach. Neither end is automatically better.
step3.q5Question: Q5. As a local Guide in Japan, what do you usually value most when recommending a place or experience? (Select all that apply.)

q5Options.photogenicScenery: Attractive scenery or surroundings that are enjoyable to visit or photograph.
q5Options.hiddenLocalExperience: Lesser-known experiences that are familiar to local residents.
q5Options.authenticDailyLife: Experiences that help guests understand everyday life in Japan.
q5Options.guestFit: Suitability for the guest’s interests, physical comfort, and preferred pace.

step3.q5SliderTooltip: When recommending a place or experience, which direction do you naturally lean toward?
step3.q5Range1: 1 — Familiar, accessible, and broadly appealing experiences
step3.q5Range9: 9 — Distinctive local experiences and less obvious details
step3.q6Question: Q6. If a guest behaves disrespectfully toward you during an experience, which actions might you take? (Select all that apply.)

q6Options.stateBoundary: Remain calm and politely explain how the behavior affects you or crosses a service boundary.
q6Options.adjustInteraction: Adjust the interaction according to the seriousness of the situation to prevent it from escalating.
q6Options.contactPlatform: Contact the platform for assistance if the behavior continues, interferes with the service, or creates a safety concern.
q6Options.stopService: Consider ending the service if safe and effective communication can no longer be maintained.
q6Options.endureSilently: Tolerate the behavior without expressing any concerns so that the experience can be completed.
q6Options.argue: Argue with the guest and insist that they admit they were wrong.

step3.q6SliderTooltip: When a guest behaves disrespectfully, which response is closer to your natural approach?
step3.q6Range1: 1 — I first try to adjust the interaction and de-escalate the situation
step3.q6Range9: 9 — I first state a clear boundary and take formal action if needed
step3.q7Question: Q7. When your personal emotions or physical condition may conflict with your work responsibilities, which response is closest to how you would usually handle the situation?

q7Options.assessAndStayProfessional: Assess my condition first and remain professional if I am still able to provide the agreed service appropriately.
q7Options.reduceSocialInteraction: Complete the essential parts of the service while reducing non-essential social interaction.
q7Options.communicateEarly: Inform the guest and the platform as early as possible if my condition may affect service quality or safety.
q7Options.alwaysContinue: Continue and complete the experience regardless of my condition.
q7Options.expressEmotion: Express my emotions openly to the guest because I believe being authentic is more important than hiding how I feel.

step3.q7SliderTooltip: If your emotional or physical condition may affect the experience, which approach is closer to yours?
step3.q7Range1: 1 — I first try to manage the situation independently while maintaining the service
step3.q7Range9: 9 — I prefer to communicate early and adjust the service if the impact may be significant
step3.q8Question: Q8. What do you consider your greatest strengths as a Guide? (Select up to three.)

q8Options.conversation: Conversation skills and the ability to create an engaging atmosphere
q8Options.adaptability: Adaptability and problem-solving in unexpected situations
q8Options.firstTimeVisitors: Ability to support guests visiting Japan for the first time
q8Options.observeNeeds: Ability to observe and respond to guests’ needs
q8Options.respectPace: Respect for guests’ pace and personal space

step3.q8ExampleQuestion: Please share one specific moment or example that best demonstrates your ability as a Guide. (Maximum 100 words.)
step3.q8ExamplePlaceholder: Describe the situation, what you did, and what it shows about you as a Guide...
step3.q8SliderTooltip: Which type of strength is more central to what you naturally bring as a Guide?
step3.q8Range1: 1 — Local knowledge, planning, and practical expertise
step3.q9Question: Q9. After the experience, what words or short sentence would you like guests to use to describe you? (Maximum 50 words.)
step3.q9Placeholder: Share how you hope guests would describe their experience with you...
